title: Module 1: Analysis & Design Phases
description: Trace how instructional designers move from learner and context analysis into concrete learning goals, sequencing, and blueprint-level design decisions.

learning_objectives.statement: Identify the key components of the Analysis phase (learner, context, task)
Explain how the Design phase translates analysis into actionable learning blueprints
Connect learner analysis data to measurable instructional objectives and content sequencing

alignment_method: deterministic lexical mapping v2 with direct-evidence fallback; instructor review required
